title: Grateful Dead Live at University Hall, University Of Virginia on 1982-09-14
lineage: Transfer: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A (Dolby-B in) > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged.
source: Source: FOB Beyers M88's > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell XLIIS-90 (1st Set, He's Gone, and JBGoode) and TDK MA-90 (2nd Set). Concert recording by Rip Tompkins, & with thanks to Richie Stankiewicz!

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording with crystal‑clear sound captures a high‑energy 1982 show featuring rare gems like High Time, Aiko Aiko and a monster Lazy Lightning → Supplication sequence.
ai_review.review: The tape is praised as the best available audience source for this era – clear, well‑balanced and free of phase problems – letting listeners enjoy a long, high‑energy set that includes standout moments such as Lazy Lightning into Supplication, the rare High Time, and an inspired Aiko Aiko → Truckin' segue.  Jerry’s vocals and lead guitar shine, Bob’s organic rhythm work is solid, and Phil adds tasty bass accents throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently enthusiastic reviews highlight a superb musical performance (many rare songs, high energy) and an excellent audience recording that is described as the best copy available.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as the best audio copy – clear stereo image, no squashed cymbals, good FOH mic capture, no phase issues; audience tape quality praised across multiple reviews.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid, long set with strong transitions (notably China>Rider) and a rare post‑drums segment; the pacing keeps momentum high throughout both sets.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for effortless, sweet lead guitar licks and powerful vocals that ‘sing from his instrument’.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted hitting great notes and adding high‑point accents, especially on the closing Deal.
band_member_comments.Bob: Described as dialed‑in with an organic tone; strong rhythm work and standout ballad performances (El Paso).
